correctness.rationale: Exact arithmetic over \(\mathbb Z_{169}\) gives nonzero remainders for both printed component polynomials. The quotient-ring multiplication maps have image cardinalities \(13^9\) and \(13^8\), so the literal printed direct sum has \(13^{17}\) words. The proposed replacements factor \(x^7-1\) and \(x^7+1\), reduce to the printed polynomials modulo \(13\), and each generate a free \(169^2\)-word component. Exhaustive enumeration of all \(28561\) words per corrected component gives minimum distance \(6\); unit Gram determinants prove both components LCD, hence the additive direct sum is ACD with \(13^8\) words and is MDS.

value.rationale: The table advertises explicit ACD MDS generator polynomials for an infinite prime-power family. At the first nontrivial lift \(t=2\), the literal published row has the wrong module cardinality by a factor of \(13^9\), so it cannot instantiate its own advertised parameters. The corrected factors are small, exact, reproducible replacements that recover the intended code and preserve the paper's abstract existence result. This is a substantive correction to a concrete construction, not a cosmetic normalization or routine recomputation.
